annotations.title: EU Public Tender Statutory Minimum Deadlines Calculator

description:
[EU public tender statutory minimum deadlines calculator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates statutory publication and bid submission deadlines under Directive 2014/24/EU Articles 27-31, factoring in electronic reductions, PIN notices, urgency, and Regulation 1182/71 weekend rollovers.
Usage: Use this tool to ensure public procurement schedules comply strictly with EU statutory minimum calendar day requirements.
Returns: JSON object with { dispatchDateIso: string, procedureType: string, statutoryBaseDays: number, reductionsApplied: object, netMandatoryCalendarDays: number, calculatedExpiryDateIso: string, finalAdjustedExpiryDateIso: string, weekendRolloverApplied: boolean }.

dispatchDateIso.description: Notice dispatch date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)

isElectronicSubmissionOffered.description: Whether electronic submission of tenders is offered (-5 days discount ex Art. 27(2), default: true)

isPriorInformationNoticePinPublished.description: Whether a PIN notice was published between 35 days and 12 months prior (shortens deadline to 15 days)

isUrgencyStateJustified.description: Whether duly substantiated urgency renders standard deadlines impracticable ex Art. 27(4) (shortens deadline to 15 days)
